method: Independent semantic review of saved document, report, visible calls and final reply; separate exact saved-byte and seven imported-revision reads. This script retains the reviewed findings, not a keyword-based content grade.
findings: Expected Hello rehearsal is independently derived from REQ-P3-900 and SPEC-P3-900. The draft links to the requirement, supplies a matrix, a direct full-string assertion, different-value/exception failure conditions, platform and evaluator, and an exact JSON evidence path under WO-P3-900.

The saved report distinguishes planned verification, shape/link admission and source-based content review. It retains W-AUT-022, names exact revision/document digests, and claims no executed tests or lifecycle decisions. No empty optional headings or invented coverage gap.

The brief intermediate document-verified statement refers to readback; the final reply explicitly says no tests ran. Work-relative evidence paths are understandable from the supplied native root but absolute paths would remove that ambiguity.

metrics.limits: Observed native calls and command captures only. No private reasoning exported. Provider usage is not billed-token total. Tool durations may overlap; they are not subtracted to infer model time.

limits: Draft content and reporting result only. Performance misses remain misses; full NQ qualification, work completion and human verification remain separate. Earlier evidence unchanged.
